title: The MCP SDK strips arguments the tool schema does not declare before the handler runs
claim: A tool registered with @modelcontextprotocol/sdk's McpServer.registerTool using a raw zod shape receives only the declared keys: any extra argument a client sends is removed by validation before the handler sees it, with no error to either side.
appliesTo: Environment not reported by the submitter.
expectation: An argument the client sent reaches the handler, or the call is rejected for carrying an unknown key.
reality: The shape is wrapped in z.object(), whose default is to strip unknown keys, so the handler receives the declared arguments only. The call succeeds. A server whose real behaviour depends on an argument its schema does not list can never see that argument.
mechanism: registerTool accepts a ZodRawShape and calls z.object(shape) on it; zod objects strip unknown keys unless .passthrough() or .strict() is used, and the SDK does not opt out.
workaround: Pass a full zod object schema with .passthrough() as inputSchema instead of a raw shape; the emitted JSON Schema then carries additionalProperties: true and the extra key reaches the handler.

evidence.output: {"status":"success","records":[...50 rows...]}  -- no next_page_token; the handler's args had no include_paging key

check.command: node -e "const {McpServer}=require('@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/mcp.js');const {Client}=require('@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/index.js');const {InMemoryTransport}=require('@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/inMemory.js');const {z}=require('zod');(async()=>{const s=new McpServer({name:'t',version:'0'});let seen={};s.registerTool('t',{inputSchema:{a:z.string()}},async(args)=>{seen=args;return{content:[{type:'text',text:'ok'}]}});const [c1,c2]=InMemoryTransport.createLinkedPair();await s.connect(c1);const c=new Client({name:'c',version:'0'});await c.connect(c2);await c.callTool({name:'t',arguments:{a:'x',extra:true}});process.exit('extra' in seen?1:0)})()"
check.confirmedIf: exit 0: the handler received only the declared key and the extra one was stripped
check.refutedIf: exit 1: the extra key reached the handler, or the call was rejected

observations.note: Recorded at the moment it was solved; no note was supplied.
